record.field: Single most common stock move from/to

Search the Stock Moves (model_name: stock.move), and find the most common move (the one with the highest count). The result should include the name of the product moved (field_name: product_id), the From location (field_name: location_id), the To location (field_name: location_dest_id), and the forecasted location if any (field_name: forecasted_location_id) of this move, the sum of the quantity moved (field_name: product_qty) and the total number of moves (count). If no forecasted location, don' t add it to the result. Don't mention model_name, field_name or any records ids in the response.
